title: Populate reflex.productivity counts
description: reflex.productivity is currently always 0. Should be the count of distinct toponyms that use this (surface_form, position) reflex, derived from toponym_etymology_element joins. Drives generator weighting later.

title: Capture word-level positional bias for modifier words
description: Single-word modifiers like 'Great', 'Long', 'Old', 'Little' are pre-only ('Great Bevvy' yes, 'Bevvy Great' no). Cardinal-direction words like 'North', 'South' are flexible (both 'North Stoke' and 'Stoke North' attested). Current schema captures intra-word morpheme position (pre/inner/post within a compound) but NOT inter-word position (which word slot in a multi-word name). Need either: (a) new name_modifier table with per-word-position counts derived from observed toponyms; (b) an inter_word_position field on something. The generator currently treats single-word modifiers as positionally free, which produces unnatural names.

title: Move confidence from toponym_etymology to per-element
description: Scholars hedge per-element ('the prefix is clearly X; the suffix may be Y'). Currently we record one confidence per breakdown. Move confidence to toponym_etymology_element; keep an aggregate on the parent for back-compat queries.

title: OCR ligature normalization for etymon canonical_form
description: Skeat OCR consistently mangles æ→cs, æ→ce, ð→§. Etymons end up as 'hcsdan' (should be 'hædan') or 'hy§' (should be 'hyð'). Add a normalize_ocr_form() pass that maps these back, applied at upsert_etymon() time. Pairs with the lemma work (variants under one lemma).
notes:
Implemented normalize_ocr_form() and cluster_ocr_variants() with dry-run/apply modes. Tested. Will run as a post-mining pass.
Lexicon README + arch note added at wyrd/generators/kenning/README.md covering data model, authoring flow, key invariants, module map, and CLI cheatsheet. Helps future-us stay oriented.
close_reason: OCR ligature normalization applied: 43 variant-pairs merged. Sat upstream of the lemma pass and let it work on cleaned forms.

title: Add lemma_id self-FK on etymon for variant collapse
description: Inflected forms (Hæda/Hædan) and OCR/macron variants (hām/hamm/ham) currently become separate etymon rows, breaking consensus counts. Add etymon.lemma_id (nullable self-FK) so variants point at a canonical lemma. Update etymon_consensus view to roll up to lemma. Backfill via clustering pass over canonical_form within each language.
close_reason: Schema migrated, inflection-strip linker shipped. 50 lemma links applied; cross-witnessed etymons rose from 113 to 133. Known false-positive class (OE adj↔noun) tolerable for now.

title: Refactor cluster_ocr_variants: extract per-table merge logic
description:
Why this exists:

cluster_ocr_variants in wyrd/generators/kenning/lexicon.py is now ~120 lines after wyrd-go5's FK fix landed. The apply-phase loop (~76 lines) is a sequence of repetitive INSERT OR IGNORE / UPDATE / DELETE blocks, one per child table that references etymon. The repetition itself was the bug surface for wyrd-go5: when a new child table (etymon_text_match) was added, the merge loop wasn't updated and silently dropped rows.

Flagged by complexity-reviewer on PR #5 (https://github.com/521-studios/wyrd/pull/5).

What needs to be done:

Two viable shapes:
1. Extract a _merge_etymon_into(db, winner_id, loser_id) helper that owns the per-table merge sequence.
2. Build a declarative _ETYMON_CHILD_TABLES dispatch list — each entry names the child table, its UNIQUE-constraint columns, and any 'self-FK' column on etymon — and iterate it. Schema discoverability becomes auditable; future child tables get caught.

Acceptance:
- cluster_ocr_variants main body drops to fit one screen (~50 lines).
- All existing tests still pass; regression coverage from wyrd-go5 still exercises the new helper.
- Adding a hypothetical new child table requires updating one declarative list, not editing the merge loop body.

Likely supersedes interaction with wyrd-et0 — if non-destructive clustering lands, the merge loop becomes much shorter (mark-as-merged via merged_into_id), and this refactor is moot. Keep open as fallback if wyrd-et0 stalls.

title: Batch SQL operations in cluster_ocr_variants
description:
gemini-code-assist (PR #3 round 2, P3) flagged: the OCR variant merging logic in `cluster_ocr_variants` (lexicon.py:1052) executes multiple SQL statements per redundant etymon inside nested loops. For large numbers of variants this becomes chatty with the DB.

Proposed: batch the deletes and citation rewrites with `IN (...)` clauses so each cluster collapse is one or two statements rather than O(N) per loser etymon.

Why deferred: cluster_ocr_variants runs occasionally during ingest, not in a hot path. Lexicon currently has ~few-hundred OCR variants tops; the chattiness hasn't caused observable slowdown. Worth doing as a focused optimization PR if/when it becomes a bottleneck.
